title: jasione sessiliflora subsp. tomentosa
intro: Jasione sessiliflora subsp. tomentosa, commonly known as Woolly Jasione, is a plant species that belongs to the bellflower family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects. The health benefits of Jasione sessiliflora subsp. tomentosa are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
